correctness.rationale: For any cyclic host choose distinct abba target starts, classify all overlaps: only swapped off-diagonal target pairs permit a two-position gap; three-position gaps preserve the first letter. This proves length >=3q^2-r+z and r<=binom(q,2); for even q indegree/outdegree parity forces omitted pairs plus long gaps >=q/2. Euler tours of K_q for odd q and K_q minus a perfect matching for even q>=4 attain bounds; q=2 explicit cyclic witness. Exact program covers constructions q=2..10, exact independent subset-DP tours q=2..4. Universal theorem is logically separate from finite experiments.
